text: {"lessons":["The decline in my account does not imply prices will rebound or keep falling; with random price changes, I should not use recent moves as a forecast.","I made no trades, which avoided impulsive reactions, but I should still review whether my holdings and cash fit my overall goals and risk tolerance.","I should judge the portfolio as a whole rather than treating each stock as a separate account or making decisions solely to avoid realizing a loss."]}
